title: Installing an App
drDigitalIntro:
Installing an app puts it on your device.
• Search for it in the App Market, then click Install.
• Free apps install straight away — paid apps charge your payment method.
• Once installed, the app appears in My Apps.
• Only install apps from the official App Market, never from random websites.

steps.say: Search for 'recipe' in the search bar.
Click on RecipeBox from the results.
Click Install to download and install it.
Click 'My Apps' to see your installed apps.

drDigitalSuccess: You installed an app! It is now in My Apps. Next we will learn about permission requests.
drDigitalHint: Search for the app, click its name, then click the Install button.
